title: Hot Work Operations Risk Assessment
description: Free Hot Work Operations Risk Assessment template for oil & gas you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers hot work information, hot work risk assessment matrix, hot work area inspection checklist.

Emergency Procedures For Hot Work

IN CASE OF FIRE:

1. STOP WORK IMMEDIATELY

2. Sound the alarm - Pull station location: ______________

3. Attempt to extinguish if small - Use appropriate extinguisher

4. EVACUATE if fire cannot be controlled

5. Account for personnel at muster point: ______________

6. Notify emergency response: ______________ Phone: ______________

IN CASE OF GAS RELEASE / ALARM:

1. STOP WORK IMMEDIATELY

2. Shut off all ignition sources

3. Evacuate area

4. Follow facility emergency procedures

IN CASE OF INJURY:

1. STOP WORK

2. Provide first aid

3. Call for medical assistance: ______________ Phone: ______________

4. Notify supervisor
